result.note: Official trade data release; tested the record export figure and the direction of the trade deficit.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's trade data for May 2026, released in June 2026:
items: India's exports reached a record USD 81.96 billion in the month.
The trade deficit narrowed to USD 10.51 billion as gold imports fell.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Exports hit a record USD 81.96 billion, but the trade deficit widened to USD 10.51 billion rather than narrowing. Gold imports and a flipped petroleum bill drove the wider gap and added fresh external strain.
questions.source: India's exports hit a record USD 81.96 billion in May, but the trade deficit widened to USD 10.51 billion as gold imports and a flipped petroleum bill opened fresh external strain.
